newsitem.title: USA: Cubist, Genzyme in drug discovery pact.
newsitem.headline: Cubist, Genzyme in drug discovery pact.

text.p: Cubist Pharmaceuticals Inc and Genzyme Corp said Tuesday they had signed a drug discovery agreement to identify novel compounds that act against pathogenic bacteria and fungi.
It is Genzyme's first collaboration in small molecule drug discovery in any therapeutic area in which its proprietary compound library is being screened, the companies said.

Under the pact, Cubist will screen Genzyme's compound library against its proprietary biological targets. Cubist's technology platform consists of more than 100 assays for anti-effective drug discovery.

Genzyme has synthesized a compound library currently consisting of more than 600,000 small molecules. Cubist will have the right of first negotiation with Genzyme to obtain a license to engage in expanded development and commercialization of active compounds discovered by the parties.
